01.title: Pomodoro Technique
01.description: Study for 25 minutes, then rest for 5. After four rounds take a long break. Keeps your mind sharp and prevents burnout.

02.title: Active Recall
02.description: After reading a unit, close your notes and write down everything you remember. Retrieval practice is far more effective than re-reading.

03.title: Past Papers First
03.description: Attempt past papers early to understand the exam format. Identify your weak areas and redirect your study time there.

04.title: Mind Maps
04.description: Draw visual maps connecting key concepts. Especially effective for Engineering Technology and Science units with many interconnected ideas.

05.title: Teach Someone
05.description: Explain a concept aloud to a friend or even to yourself. The Feynman Technique reveals gaps in your understanding instantly.

06.title: Sleep & Review
06.description: Review your notes just before sleep. Your brain consolidates memories during sleep — take advantage of this biological superpower.

disclaimerPage.title: Disclaimer
disclaimerPage.lastUpdated: This page was last updated August 2026.
disclaimerPage.p1: PastPaperZone is an independent, student-run project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to the Department of Examinations, Sri Lanka, or the Ministry of Education in any way.
disclaimerPage.p2: All past papers and marking schemes on this site are exam materials that were already released to the public. We collect and organise them for free, easy access - we do not claim authorship of the original exam content.
disclaimerPage.p3: We try our best to make sure every paper and marking scheme is correctly labelled and complete, but mistakes can happen (a wrong year, a wrong medium, a missing page). Please cross-check important details with your school or tuition class before an exam.
disclaimerPage.p4: Everything on this site is provided for personal study purposes, free of charge. Please do not re-upload or resell this content elsewhere.
disclaimerPage.p5: If you believe a file infringes your rights, or you've spotted an error, use the "Request Missing Paper" or "Contact Us" form and we will review it promptly.
